---------------------------------- **LIMITED ACCESS** -----------------------------

**(Opens only on weekends)**

You're a bear. You're inside a fairytale village. You've got 10 minutes to swallow every magical artifact in sight and flush yourself out before another critter steals your haul. This is Fabula. 

A **free** VR extraction adventure for Quest 2 & 3 — mischievous fairy-tale critters, storybook raids, and the funniest inventory system in VR.

# 🍝 EAT THE TALE 
Your belly IS your inventory. Swallow loot to carry it. Overeat and you gag. Die and your haul bursts out for everyone to grab. Find an extraction toilet, flush yourself out, and turn every artifact into Fame.

# 🎯 HIGH-STAKES RAIDS

Boss-guarded artifacts. Up to 10 players competing for the same loot. Every run escalates.

# ⚔️ PvPvE COOPETITIVE 
10 players every raid. Co-op with your party. Compete with everyone else. Every artifact is contested. Pure chaos!
# ✨ GROW YOUR LEGEND 
Extracted loot becomes Fame. Fame levels your Tale. Unlock new gear, relics, and powers. Hit Tale Level 60, go Legacy, start over stronger.

**Find the toilet. Flush the magic. Become a legend.**
